workload.prompt_template: Output exactly 200 repetitions of token{nonce} separated by one space. Do not explain and do not stop early.

caveats: The MLX and Ollama repositories use different 4-bit formats, so this is a same-family and same-size runtime probe rather than exact-weight equivalence.
Decode throughput excludes model loading and is not time to first token or end-to-end latency.
The vllm-mlx built-in benchmark generates its own short prompts and is not directly paired with the MLX/Ollama prompt; it is retained as a backend suitability probe.
The prompt deliberately forces 64 output tokens. It is not representative of response quality or normal chat content.
